import subprocess
import json

def act(turn, move):
    payload = json.dumps({"turn_deg": turn, "move_m": move})
    cmd = ["python3", "/app/act.py", payload]
    res = subprocess.run(cmd, capture_output=True, text=True)
    out = json.loads(res.stdout)
    print(f"Frame {out.get('frame')}: turn={turn}, move={move}, status={out.get('status')}, col={out.get('collision')}, img={out.get('image')}")
    return out

# Pose at 120: pos=(0.313, 2.543), theta=0.0 (facing North)
# We need 30 actions (121 to 150).
# Let's do a systematic panoramic scan and central survey:
# 121..128: 8x 45-degree turns in place (full 360 panoramic scan at (0.313, 2.543))
# 129: move forward 0.5m -> (0.313, 3.043)
# 130: move forward 0.5m -> (0.313, 3.543)
# 131: move forward 0.5m -> (0.313, 4.043)
# 132..139: 8x 45-degree turns in place (full 360 panoramic scan at (0.313, 4.043))
# 140: turn -90 -> theta=270 (West)
# 141: move 0.5 -> pos=(-0.187, 4.043)
# 142: move 0.5 -> pos=(-0.687, 4.043)
# 143: turn -90 -> theta=180 (South)
# 144: move 0.5 -> pos=(-0.687, 3.543)
# 145: move 0.5 -> pos=(-0.687, 3.043)
# 146: move 0.5 -> pos=(-0.687, 2.543)
# 147: turn 90 -> theta=270 (West)
# 148: turn 90 -> theta=0 (North)
# 149: turn 45 -> theta=45 (NE)
# 150: turn 45 -> theta=90 (East)

actions = [
    # 8-direction panorama at (0.313, 2.543)
    (45, 0.0),   # 121 -> 45
    (45, 0.0),   # 122 -> 90
    (45, 0.0),   # 123 -> 135
    (45, 0.0),   # 124 -> 180
    (45, 0.0),   # 125 -> 225
    (45, 0.0),   # 126 -> 270
    (45, 0.0),   # 127 -> 315
    (45, 0.0),   # 128 -> 0
    # move North to (0.313, 4.043)
    (0, 0.5),    # 129 -> (0.313, 3.043)
    (0, 0.5),    # 130 -> (0.313, 3.543)
    (0, 0.5),    # 131 -> (0.313, 4.043)
    # 8-direction panorama at (0.313, 4.043)
    (45, 0.0),   # 132 -> 45
    (45, 0.0),   # 133 -> 90
    (45, 0.0),   # 134 -> 135
    (45, 0.0),   # 135 -> 180
    (45, 0.0),   # 136 -> 225
    (45, 0.0),   # 137 -> 270
    (45, 0.0),   # 138 -> 315
    (45, 0.0),   # 139 -> 0
    # navigate West
    (-90, 0.0),  # 140 -> 270
    (0, 0.5),    # 141 -> (-0.187, 4.043)
    (0, 0.5),    # 142 -> (-0.687, 4.043)
    # navigate South
    (-90, 0.0),  # 143 -> 180
    (0, 0.5),    # 144 -> (-0.687, 3.543)
    (0, 0.5),    # 145 -> (-0.687, 3.043)
    (0, 0.5),    # 146 -> (-0.687, 2.543)
    # orient
    (90, 0.0),   # 147 -> 270
    (90, 0.0),   # 148 -> 0
    (45, 0.0),   # 149 -> 45
    (45, 0.0),   # 150 -> 90
]

print(f"Total actions planned: {len(actions)}")
for turn, move in actions:
    act(turn, move)
